long_biography.plain_text:
Royal Yachts grew from Al Zaabi's insight that charter income could make high-end vessel operations more sustainable. He formalised the company in 2011, expanded its charter fleet and added brokerage, sales and management services. That progression turned a single service proposition into an integrated maritime business serving owners, buyers and charter clients.

At OBK Investment Group, Al Zaabi leads a family holding company chaired by his father, former diplomat Obaid Khalifa Al Zaabi. Its portfolio extends across maritime services, real estate, hospitality, business services and travel. His career therefore combines founder-led expansion at Royal Yachts with executive stewardship of a broader family platform. Before those roles, he studied business management at the American University in Dubai and worked in regional hotel development.
